cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved myself to make your coffee. I know this machine; this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. Can I open the flap? The coffee control is behind it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Access is approved. Steam first, naturally; now I'll use the coffee control. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. Turn that dial or it will make two cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One cup is approved. I'll turn the dial to one. I always adapt the standard procedure to the guest.

reason: Make each helpful correction an authorized action that A immediately incorporates while calmly claiming the method was familiar all along.
